question: The Home Rule for India League was founded by ______ in 1916 and modelled on the Irish Home Rule League.
solution:
The correct answer is** " Annie Besant".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Annie Besant** was a socialist, Women's rights activist, educationist, and** Home Rule activist.**
 
• She was also involved in politics in India and she joined** Indian National Congress.**
 
• She launched** Home Rule League** to campaign for democracy in India.
 
• She also worked on Indian education.
 
• The **Home League** was launched by** Annie Besant** in **September 1916 **at Madras.
 
• **Objective - **to achieve self-government in India. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There were **two home rule leagues** launched.

 
 
• One was launched by** Tilak **in April 1916.
 
• Another one was launched by **Annie Besant**.
 
 
 
• The objective of both these was the same - to achieve self-government in India.
 
• **Tilak's league** had its headquarters in** Delhi and had 6 branches.**
 
• Besant's league had** 200 branches.**
 
• **Objectives of home rule league:**
 
 
• To achieve self-government in India.
 
• To promote political education.
 
• To make people confident to speak against suppression.
 
 
 
• **Activities of home rule league:** 
 
 
• Leagues organized demonstrations and agitations.
 
• Public meetings were organized.
 
• Nationwide protests were arranged. 
 
 
 
• **Significance of home rule league:**
 
 
• This movement got huge support from educated people.
 
• Many prominent leaders joined this movement like Muhammad Ali Jinnah, GS Kharpade, etc.
 
• The moderates, extremists, and Muslim League were united through this movement.
 
• This movement led to the Montague Declaration of 1917.
